_meta.rule: Facts, not assumptions. Draw lists use only proven or likely facts. Geometry-only items (bearings computed from mapped points) are tagged likely unless a page or photo backs them.
_meta.angles: Bearings are degrees true from the stand. Late-November sunset about 238, June sunset about 306 at this latitude.
_meta.sides: left/right/centre/behind are relative to facingDeg. na = not tied to a direction.
_meta.extraKeys: cowlitz-blue-creek is not an app spot id. It is the second Cowlitz bank site the app names (Blue Creek / trout hatchery outlet). The builder should decide with Coach which one the cowlitz id paints.
